name: Kasia
summary: Encrypted peer-to-peer messenger and protocol on Kaspa. Messages travel inside Kaspa transactions marked ciph_msg, and an optional indexer syncs them across devices. Open source.
status_note: Messages in its ciph_msg format were accepted on mainnet on 21 Oct 2026. Older KaChat clients write the same format, so a single transaction doesn't prove which app sent it. No new code since 27 Jun 2026; the latest release is v0.6.2 (9 Oct 2025).

evidence.label: ciph_msg defined in Kasia's protocol config

code.note: The app is ISC-licensed. The kasia-indexer repo has no licence file.

audit.note: None published that we could find.

conflict: Kasia competes with KaspaChat, which Kaspaguy builds.
